entry.title: New: Resolution 463 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF A LATER FISCAL YEAR AND OF MORE THAN ONE FISCAL YEAR FOR MULTI-YEAR LEASES FOR THREE MULTI-FUNCTION COPY MACHINES FOR THE PLANNING DEPARTMENT

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into five-year lease agreements with an approximate monthly cost of $275 for each copier, to be used by the department’s Hilo and Kona offices.
